content.text: {"affected_statement":"L1.2","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"no","elsewhere_quote":null,"status_as_written":"not_established","repair_distance":"sentence","explanation":"The write-up states the required divisor-set equivalence but explicitly omits its proof, and no other passage proves it for all nonnegative α,β. A single sentence suffices: assume without loss of generality α≤β; then (α′,β′)=(α,β−α), and t divides α and β iff it divides α and β−α. This also covers zero and equal valuations. Since all other valuations are unchanged, the gcd of the entire tuple is then invariant."}
